sourceData.mnemonic:
You're being <kanji>invited</kanji>, but you're also being <kanji>misguided</kanji>. This is <vocabulary>seduction</vocabulary> that's talking. A misguided invitation is never a good thing!

This word also translates to <vocabulary>temptation</vocabulary>, but keep in mind that <ja>誘惑</ja>’s focus is more on an external factor that entices someone into succumbing to temptation.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: This is a jukugo word, which usually means on'yomi readings from the kanji. If you know the readings of your kanji you'll know how to read this as well.
